name: Teachable
tagline: Online course platform for creators to sell lessons, coaching, and digital products

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Starter listed at $39/month monthly and $29/month annually, with 7.5% transaction fee.

verdictSummary: A basic course site with Stripe can be built, but student apps, tax/payments, course compliance, certificates, upsells, affiliates, and support make full parity hard.
coreLoopDIY: Build lessons/modules, student login, progress tracking, Stripe checkout, and gated course pages.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because course businesses need checkout, access, progress, and support to just work.

priorArt.name: Moodle
priorArt.desc: Mature open-source learning management system; powerful but heavier than Teachable.

notes: Important because course platforms are very tempting to DIY but full business flows are deep.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Teachable (Online course platform for creators to sell lessons, coaching, and digital products). Requirements:

- Core loop: Build lessons/modules, student login, progress tracking, Stripe checkout, and gated course pages.
- Needs: auth.
- Needs: payment processor.
- Needs: course CMS.
- Needs: video/file hosting.
- Needs: email receipts.
- Needs: hosting.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: student apps; payments/tax workflows; certificates.
